item.herbs.name: Healing Herbs
item.herbs.description: A bundle of silvery-green leaves that smell of mint and morning dew. The village healers swear by them.

item.bread.name: Loaf of Bread
item.bread.description: A round loaf with a golden crust, still faintly warm. Bronn's own recipe, and the closest thing to a feast on the road.

item.silver_bell.name: Silver Bell
item.silver_bell.description: A tiny silver bell from an acrobat's cap, stolen long ago by goblins who liked how shiny it was.

item.spider_silk.name: Spider Silk
item.spider_silk.description: A spool of pale, shimmering thread, strong as steel wire and light as air.

item.deer_antler.name: Great Deer Antler
item.deer_antler.description: A branch-like antler shed by the Great Deer. A faint green light still pulses inside it.

item.nail_crown.name: Crown of Nails
item.nail_crown.description: A crown of bent iron nails, heavy and ugly. Gorak wore it, and every orc obeyed.

item.charm.name: Blue Ribbon Charm
item.charm.description: A small silver star on a blue ribbon, blessed by Priestess Elara. It feels warm in your palm.

item.fountain.name: Stone Fountain
item.fountain.description: A weathered fountain at the heart of the plaza, murmuring the same quiet song for centuries.
